split.note: Holdout scene ids are declared here, as data. Tuning code must read the 'calibration' list; it must never name a holdout scene. A 'recorded' scene is captured and committed and read by nothing: no fit, no self-check, no bound and no claim may cite it. A 'probe' scene is the other way round: fits and claims read it, and no adopted bound, regression floor or conditioning exclusion is stated over it, so the frozen bed's gate does not move with it.

caveats: W34 G2 projection: G1 omitted the caveats key; no fixture metadata or pixel changed. Native-only controls are excluded by G0 launcher.
